content: Branches open at nine and close at five, Monday to Saturday. Only the central branch opens on Sunday, from noon until four. Every branch closes on a public holiday, and the reading room opens an hour after the branch it sits in.

An adult card carries twenty items for three weeks, renewable twice unless another reader has placed a hold. A junior card carries ten items and no audiovisual stock. Reference stock is consulted in the building and is never lent.

A late return is charged ten pence a day to a cap of five pounds, after a one-day grace period. Junior cards accrue no charge. A lost item is billed at replacement cost rather than as a fine, and borrowing stops once a balance passes ten pounds.
